say:1:1211316001:0.text: Did you hear that? That Graveborn lady said Sinbad's maneuvering with their fleet!
say:1:1211316001:0.source_cn: 你们听见了吗，那个亡灵女人说辛巴达正在和他们的舰队周旋！

say:3:1211316002:1.text: Bonnie... You don't know her well, but this is a chance I can't pass up. I've faced her in battle many times.
say:3:1211316002:1.source_cn: 波妮……你们还不了解她。我们交过很多次手。

say:4:1211316003:0.text: Besides commanding in battles, she's also a formidable archer. From my previous clashes with her, she's able to precisely target navigators or the helmsman. She's a tough opponent.
say:4:1211316003:0.source_cn: 除了指挥作战，她用弓也很强。几次海上相逢，我们的船能靠...

say:5:1211316004:0.text: It takes just a single second of chaos before the Graveborn set up grappling hooks and rope ladders, turning sea battles into hand-to-hand combat. Many of my crew have fallen at her hands...
say:5:1211316004:0.source_cn: 只需要片刻慌乱，那群亡灵就能搭起钩索和绳梯，然后就是刀...

say:6:1211316005:0.text: If we can take her down here, it will be a major blow to Hodgkin!
say:6:1211316005:0.source_cn: 如果能在这里干掉她，就能断掉霍德希金一条手臂……！

say:8:1211316006:0.text: Calm down, Sonja! You look like you're about to start breathing fire like a dragon!

say:9:1211316007:0.text: We came here to gather intel on the Dead Tide Fleet. If we act recklessly, we'll be exposed!
say:9:1211316007:0.source_cn: 我们来这里是为了摸清死潮舰队的底细。要是贸然出击，就完...

say:10:1211316008:1.text: I know. But I will get my way someday... There has been too much blood spilled. My fallen Whispers must be avenged.
say:10:1211316008:1.source_cn: 我知道。但我不会忍耐很久……血薇帮流出过的鲜血，必须要...

say:11:1211316009:0.text: Psst. Someone distract her... By the way, why don't we try using the magic communicator Hugin gave us? We can let Sinbad know what we overheard.
say:11:1211316009:0.source_cn: 对了，趁现在，要试试呼金给的魔法通讯器吗？可以把我们听...

say:12:1211316010:0.text: We should warn them to prepare for those two, they seem very menacing.
say:12:1211316010:0.source_cn: 他和呼金不一定是刚才那两个人的对手……

choice_prompt:13:1211316010.text: We should warn them to prepare for those two, they seem very menacing.
choice_prompt:13:1211316010.source_cn: 他和呼金不一定是刚才那两个人的对手……

say:17:1211316012:0.text: Ahem. Sinbad, are you there? Can you hear me?
say:17:1211316012:0.source_cn: 咳……嗯，辛巴达，在吗？能听到吗？

say:27:1211316014:0.text: Oh oh, Chippy wants to try too! Sinbad, it's us!
say:27:1211316014:0.source_cn: 咦，真的有声音！辛巴达，是我们！

say:38:1211316017:0.text: ... It got cut off. Hugin's gadgets usually work great, but this one is still being tested.
say:38:1211316017:0.source_cn: ……中断了。呼金做的东西，果然不多试验几次就不行。
say:38:1211316017:0.male: ... It got cut off. Hugin's gadgets usually work great, but this one is still being tested.
say:38:1211316017:0.female: ... It got cut off. Hugin's gadgets usually work great, but this one is still being tested.

say:39:1211316018:0.text: It's alright, let's put our faith in Sinbad. I doubt anything bad will happen to him, he's got the luck of a cat with nine lives.
say:39:1211316018:0.source_cn: 先收好，相信辛巴达那小子的技术和运气吧。
say:39:1211316018:0.male: It's alright, let's put our faith in Sinbad. I doubt anything bad will happen to him, he's got the luck of a cat with nine lives.
say:39:1211316018:0.female: It's alright, let's put our faith in Sinbad. I doubt anything bad will happen to him, he's got the luck of a cat with nine lives.

say:40:1211316019:0.text: We need to find a way <style="highlight">through the patrol area</style> and catch up with those two Graveborn. Let's see if we can overhear some more crucial information.
say:40:1211316019:0.source_cn: 咱们得想办法<style=highlight>通过前面...
say:40:1211316019:0.male: We need to find a way <style="highlight">through the patrol area</style> and catch up with those two Graveborn. Let's see if we can overhear some more crucial information.
say:40:1211316019:0.female: We need to find a way <style="highlight">through the patrol area</style> and catch up with those two Graveborn. Let's see if we can overhear some more crucial information.

choice:13:0:1.text: Let's hope he's not too busy.
choice:13:0:1.male: Let's hope he's not too busy.
choice:13:0:1.female: Let's hope he's not too busy.

choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 他能灵活兼顾海战和联络？

choice:13:2:3.text: I want to try out new tech!
choice:13:2:3.male: I want to try out new tech!
